title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
excerpt: A puzzle game where you build a GPU out of simple parts.
content_html:
Wrong pixels are marked

画错的像素会标出来

Click a wrong pixel to step back to the cycle that drew it. Every wire shows its value.

点一下画错的像素，电路回到画出它的那个周期，每根导线都显示数值。

You build it as a circuit

全部用电路搭

A circuit has no loops. To count, you build a counter from a register and an adder. Bigger circuits take more area, which counts in your score.

电路里没有循环。要计数，就用寄存器和加法器搭一个计数器。电路越大面积越大，面积计入分数。

Finished parts are reused

造好的元件后面还要用

Most levels build one part of the GPU, like the Rasterizer here. Once it passes, the game explains what it does in a real GPU, and later levels use it.

Later levels run on your part, never a built-in copy. Your circuits compute every pixel, so a slow or big Rasterizer costs area, delay and cycles in every circuit that uses it.

多数关卡造GPU里的一个部件，比如图中的光栅化器。过关后，游戏会说明它在真正的GPU里做什么，后面的关卡会用到它。

后面的关卡用的就是你造的元件，不会换成系统自带的版本。每个像素都由你的电路算出，所以光栅化器又慢又大的话，用到它的电路在面积、延迟和周期数上都会吃亏。
